items.name: osc + kaleid
items.description: Rotating oscillator sent through an 8-fold kaleidoscope. Canonical first patch on the Hydra examples site.

items.name: noise → modulate
items.description: Perlin noise modulating a slow oscillator — fluid organic motion. Demonstrates the .modulate() chain.

items.name: voronoi tiles
items.description: Animated voronoi cells with color shift. Good starting point for generative tiled visuals.

items.name: p5 circles
items.description: Circles orbiting the center, synced to the transport beat. Minimal p5 sketch in canonical (unprefixed) syntax.

items.name: p5 flowfield
items.description: Noise-based flow field agents. Showcases p5's Perlin noise and vector math, isolated from Hydra's own noise().

items.name: mercury arpeggio
items.description: A minor-scale arpeggio on a saw synth — shortest idiomatic Mercury patch: set scale, new synth, note list.
items.content:
set tempo 110
set scale minor

new synth saw time(1/8) note(0 0 2 4 5 4 2 0) shape(1 1/16 0.5) gain(0.5)

items.name: mercury poly chord
items.description: Chord progression from Roman numerals on a polySynth, with reverb on the bus. Canonical Mercury example from the upstream readme.
items.content:
set tempo 100
set scale dorian d

list prog chordsFromNumerals([I7 IIIm7 IV7 V7])
new polySynth saw name(chrd)
  set chrd note(prog 1) time(2/1) shape(1 2/1) super(3 0.13) gain(0.5)

set all fx(reverb 0.4 5)

items.name: csound FM bell
items.description: A classic 2-operator FM bell using Csound's foscili opcode. Sparse, resonant, with long tail. Minimal CSD illustrating the structure.
items.content:
<CsoundSynthesizer>
<CsOptions>
-odac
</CsOptions>
<CsInstruments>
sr = 44100
ksmps = 32
nchnls = 2
0dbfs = 1

giSine ftgen 1, 0, 16384, 10, 1

instr 1
  kEnv expseg 1, p3, 0.001
  aBell foscili 0.2 * kEnv, p4, 1, 3.5, kEnv * 4, giSine
  outs aBell, aBell
endin

</CsInstruments>
<CsScore>
i 1 0    3 440
i 1 1.5  3 660
i 1 3    4 330
</CsScore>
</CsoundSynthesizer>

items.name: csound granular
items.description: Granular texture via the `grain` opcode. Dense cloud of short sinewave grains — pure Csound territory, no equivalent in Strudel or Mercury.
items.content:
<CsoundSynthesizer>
<CsOptions>
-odac
</CsOptions>
<CsInstruments>
sr = 44100
ksmps = 32
nchnls = 2
0dbfs = 1

giSine ftgen 1, 0, 16384, 10, 1
giWin  ftgen 2, 0, 512,   20, 2

instr 1
  kAmp    linseg 0, 0.5, 0.25, p3 - 1, 0.25, 0.5, 0
  kPitch  line   p4, p3, p4 * 1.5
  kDens   line   30, p3, 80
  aGrain  grain  kAmp, kPitch, kDens, 20, 0.02, 0.1, giSine, giWin, 1
  outs aGrain, aGrain
endin

</CsInstruments>
<CsScore>
i 1 0 6 220
</CsScore>
</CsoundSynthesizer>
